channel.title: Federal News Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Federal News Network (federalnewsnetwork.com)

item.title: The right direction on MAPS?
item.description: MAPS is duplicative of a host of existing governmentwide acquisition contract (GWAC) vehicles for professional and IT services.

item.title: DoD plans to spend entire $152 billion from reconciliation bill in one year
item.description: The Trump administration previously said it would spend $113.3 billion in fiscal 2026.

item.title: HHS seeks to ‘effectively dismantle’ research office evaluating impact of its programs
item.description: The Administration for Children and Families' research arm faces a major restructuring, and will soon answer to political leaders it was independent from.

item.title: Think an old tax issue is behind you? The IRS says otherwise
item.description: "It's more than just failure to pay and the failure to file — it's correcting past affirmative misstatements to the IRS as well," Tino Lisella said.

item.title: Secret Service focusing on card skimming fraud as part of financial protection mission
item.description: "When it comes to law enforcement and especially this effort, it's a whole-community approach. The Secret Service can't do it alone," Michael Peck said.

item.title: A culture reset at NASA is underway. Will it stick this time?
item.description: NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman wants to shift away from a heavy contractor workforce, and instead hire and train feds to deliver better outcomes.

item.title: OPM to tighten reins on federal employees’ performance reviews
item.description: A new proposal addresses “inflated” evaluations for federal employees and the failure to “materially differentiate” between performance levels, OPM said.

item.title: Hegseth warns Anthropic to let the military use the company’s AI tech as it sees fit, AP sources say
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is pressuring Anthropic to give the military broader access to its artificial intelligence technology or lose its Pentagon contract. Defense officials warned Tuesday that they could designate Anthropic a supply chain risk or use the Defense Production Act to essentially give the military more authority to use its products even if it doesn’t approve of how they are used. item.title: Pentagon eyes 2028 to deliver much-delayed background investigation system
item.description: Lawmakers remain concerned about a now decade-long effort to replace legacy background investigation systems with modern technologies and processes.

item.title: Contractors: Bye, shutdowns. Hello, new-era NASA and FIFA World Cup.
item.description: The World Cup "is the equivalent of 78 Super Bowls in 40 days. This is really a great role for contractors to show the value that they bring," Jim Carroll said.
